Armor enhancement relies entirely on the four Great Fairies: each additional Fairy awakened raises all armor's maximum enhancement star level by one star, and only by awakening all four can you upgrade to 4 stars. Awakening costs no Rupees — it follows a musical troupe quest line. This article explains the four Fairies' locations, quests, and enhancement costs all at once.

The four Great Fairies: Tera (Woodland Stable), Mija (Snowfield Stable), Kaysa (Outskirt Stable), Cotera (Dueling Peaks Stable).

Enhancement costs increase with star level: 2 stars cost 50 Rupees, 3 stars 200 Rupees, and 4 stars 500 Rupees, plus specified materials.

大妖精的唤醒必须完成乌玛纳利乐团的情节挑战。第一步去利特村附近的白诘报社，和总编辑三叶交谈，开启情节挑战「追求真相！萨尔达公主的传闻」。然后准备两样东西：第一，捕捉并登录一匹普通马，攒驿站点数换取牵引挽具——后面拖乐团马车全靠它；第二，去森林驿站找沛恩和乌玛纳利乐团，开启第一首小夜曲。

Awakening the Great Fairies requires completing the Stable Trotters' side adventures. The first step is to go to the Lucky Clover Gazette near Rito Village and talk to editor-in-chief Traysi, starting the side adventure “Potential Princess Sightings!” Then prepare two things: first, catch and register an ordinary horse, and save up stable points to exchange for a Towing Harness — dragging the troupe's wagon later relies entirely on it; second, go to Woodland Stable to find Penn and the Stable Trotters, starting the first serenade.

第一位：蒂拉（森林驿站）
First: Tera (Woodland Stable)
森林驿站在中央海拉鲁右上角。到了驿站门口，沛恩和乐团成员会说要帮忙修车：用旁边的轮子把乐团马车修好，再去驿站老板处领一匹有牵引力的马，装上牵引挽具，用究极手把挽具和马车连起来，骑马拖着乐团去山上的巨大花蕾处。演奏结束，蒂拉现身。蒂拉解放后，地图上会标注其余三位大妖精的位置。

Woodland Stable is at the upper right of Central Hyrule. When you arrive at the stable's entrance, Penn and the troupe members will ask for help repairing the wagon: use the wheels nearby to repair the troupe's wagon, then get a horse with towing power from the stable owner, fit it with the Towing Harness, use Ultrahand to connect the harness to the wagon, and ride the horse towing the troupe to the giant flower bud on the hill. Once the performance ends, Tera appears. After Tera is freed, the map will mark the locations of the other three Great Fairies.
第二位：弥佳（雪原驿站）
Second: Mija (Snowfield Stable)
雪原驿站在地图左上角。乐团说要找回圆号手余福尔，他在塔邦挞大桥驿站附近，沿着道路走、看到冒烟的洞就能找到他。余福尔归队后，用究极手给马车加上车顶（木板封顶），再用马匹拖曳出发，演奏唤醒弥佳。

Snowfield Stable is at the upper left of the map. The troupe says they need to find horn player Eustus, who is near Tabantha Bridge Stable — follow the road, and you'll find him when you see a smoking cave. After Eustus rejoins, use Ultrahand to add a roof to the wagon (planks sealing the top), then tow it off with horses and perform to awaken Mija.
第三位：西莎（平原外围驿站）
Third: Kaysa (Outskirt Stable)
平原外围驿站在初始台地附近。乐团要找回笛子手菲伊，他在高原驿站附近的树上：收集 10 只静静萤火虫交给他，他就归队。归队后组装一台能越过岩石的左纳乌越野车，拖着乐团出发，演奏唤醒西莎。

Outskirt Stable is near the Great Sky Island. The troupe needs to find flute player Pyper, who is in a tree near Highland Stable: collect 10 Sunset Fireflies and give them to him, and he'll rejoin. After he rejoins, assemble a Zonai off-road vehicle that can cross rocks, tow the troupe off, and perform to awaken Kaysa.
第四位：可秋拉（双子驿站）
Fourth: Cotera (Dueling Peaks Stable)
双子驿站在双子山附近。乐团要找回太鼓手毕兹，他在卡卡利科村附近：交给他 3 个蜂蜜，他就回到双子驿站。这次要渡河：用木板搭在马车上，配合风扇和操纵杆做成一艘简易小船，顺河开到对面的巨大花蕾处，演奏唤醒可秋拉。至此四位全部唤醒。

Dueling Peaks Stable is near the Dueling Peaks. The troupe needs to find drummer Beetz, who is near Kakariko Village: give him 3 Courser Bee Honey, and he'll return to Dueling Peaks Stable. This time you have to cross a river: lay planks on the wagon, and combined with Fans and a Steering Stick make a simple boat, sailing down the river to the giant flower bud on the other side, and perform to awaken Cotera. At this point all four are awakened.
星级上限：每多解放一位大妖精，所有大妖精可提供的最高强化阶段就增加一星。解放 1 位可升 1 星，解放全部 4 位才能升到 4 星。

Star cap: each additional Great Fairy freed raises the maximum enhancement stage all Great Fairies can offer by one star. Freeing 1 lets you upgrade to 1 star; only freeing all 4 lets you upgrade to 4 stars.
